name: What preparations do I need to make before my cabinet replacement installation?

mainEntity.name: What preparations do I need to make before my cabinet replacement installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your cabinet replacement installation, you'll need to clear out all contents from your existing cabinets and countertops. It's also advisable to protect adjacent areas and flooring with drop cloths or plastic sheeting, as demolition and installation can generate dust and debris. If you're also planning other kitchen renovations, such as flooring or painting, consider the optimal order of operations to streamline the project. Our team will provide a detailed checklist specific to your project, ensuring your Nampa home is ready for a smooth and efficient installation, helping to prevent delays and protect your belongings.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear out existing cabinets, protect nearby areas from dust, and coordinate with other renovations. We will provide a specific checklist for your project preparation.
